text:
alex_dev: Handoff — I'm oncall until 04/03 20:00 UTC. Planned deploy at 2026-04-03 18:30 UTC (app-server + small DB migration). Expected canary 10% for 15m. Risk: index create may spike IO. If anything goes wrong, flip feature flag `search_v2` off.

maria_pm: Thanks — FYI marketing has a push at 19:00 UTC so minimize visible regressions. Who's primary rollout watcher? :eyes:

chris_sre: I'll be primary watcher for the window. I'll monitor p50/p95/p99, error rate, and infra metrics. Sam can be secondary.

sam_platform: I'm available as secondary. I'll join #deploy-canary at 18:20 UTC and keep a terminal open. @alex_dev can you paste rollback steps here?

alex_dev: Rollback steps: ```1) Disable rollout/feature flag: PATCH /api/flags/search_v2 -> off 2) Redeploy previous image: kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:2026-04-02-rc3 -n prod 3) If DB migration applied, run: ./scripts/db/undo_20260403.sh 4) Announce rollback in #incidents and ping shard owners```

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze window tonight 22:00-05:00 UTC. No new deploys after 22:00 — only emergency fixes. Add watchers if needed. :warning:

chris_sre: Pre-canary checklist (short): `curl -sS https://health.prod.redwood.ai/ready` -> OK, check `kubectl logs -l app=api -n prod --tail 200` for KV cache errors, confirm Redis replication lag < 100ms, confirm disk IO < 70% on primary DB.

alex_dev: Added watchers in the deploy job: primary=chris_sre, secondary=sam_platform. Canary target: 10% traffic in us-west-2. Smoke tests: login, basic search, embeddings endpoint. I'll kick off canary at 18:30 and hold for 15m.

maria_pm: Quick note on alerting thresholds — please page if errors > 1% sustained for 5m or p95 latency > 800ms. Marketing wants rollback if users see search regressions.

chris_sre: Setting alerts now: error_rate > 1% for 5m -> page oncall, p95 > 800ms -> page oncall. Also enabling synthetic probe at 30s interval for the canary cohort.

sam_platform: On standby. If I'm unresponsive for >5m during the window, escalate to @ops_lead. I'll have permissions to run the rollback commands.

alex_dev: FYI DB migration is CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (online) but still can spike IO. If we see IO > 75% I'll pause the migration and revert to phased index approach.

maria_pm: Confirmed — no PII schema changes, legal/SEC notified.

chris_sre: Got it. I'll post a short post-deploy summary here (checks, anomalies, final decision) and then close the thread. Good handoff, thanks. :thumbsup:
